name: Rear Three Quarter S Curve
pose_description: rear three-quarter view of the body, wide stance, hips shifted with a clear upward S-curve on the near hip, torso slightly rotated away from camera, one arm reaching forward, the other arm extended back. Camera 3 meters behind her and slightly to her left, at waist height, angled a few degrees up, pointing at her lower back and the raised hip. Full body in frame, 85mm, f/2.8. Do not change face, outfit, hair, or background.
